verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents work with the Stripe API, and the Financial Connections use-cases page lists agent-powered spending analysis and balance and transaction monitoring via Link CLI. That gives a first-party route to agent-mediated, natural-language operation, but the evidence does not show which Financial Connections operations the MCP tools cover, and there is no native natural-language interface. Missing for 10: confirmation that the MCP server exposes Financial Connections operations, any native natural-language command interface, detailed docs of agent workflows for this product, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
